ops.title: The user forbids local docs builds (gd-build/quarto) in cc-transcript — push and let docs CI be the gate
ops.body:
Never run the local docs build (`gd-build build` / quarto render) in cc-transcript as a pre-push gate. Said twice on 2026-07-19 during the v14.5.0 release: "dont build the docs thats a waste of tiem" and "dont waste time building docs locally ever".

**Why:** The render takes many minutes, loads the machine (pandoc + gd_build), and docs CI re-renders on every push anyway — a broken executable cell surfaces there, and [[cc-guides-is-homebrew-binary]] / the ci-triage agent handle a red run cheaper than local pre-verification.

**How to apply:** Edit docs/fragments freely, run only `slop-cop` prose checks locally, push, and let the Documentation workflow be the gate. This overrides AGENTS.md's "Docs" bullet (keep the docs build green via the local gd-build command) as a *local pre-push* step — the green requirement stands, CI enforces it.
